Suggested in a review of #96 at commit 07791aafa89b9ae60a1ffdd4cdf887e7167c0d89.

**The reviewed commit is not part of the branch of #96:** the branch was rewritten after commit 07791aafa89b9ae60a1ffdd4cdf887e7167c0d89 (its head was e001d679e49071743cd336a07ce7fc10d8e29a61 when this was proposed). GitHub shows this pull request's changes from an older merge base, so they also list changes of the reviewed commit itself. Projected onto that head before this pull request was created, merging it applies only its own changes, which are these:

- Edited [docs/experiments/fidelity/sample.md line 10 at 07791aa](https://github.com/mike-north/doc-linter/blob/07791aafa89b9ae60a1ffdd4cdf887e7167c0d89/docs/experiments/fidelity/sample.md#L10)
